# Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram

Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram, abbreviated RKKP, is the Danish organization behind the annual report of the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], a national quality database tracking assessment and treatment of ADHD within Danish child and adolescent psychiatry [^src1]. RKKP's analyses for the report were carried out by RKKP's own Videncenter (knowledge centre), and the organization is listed as the report's publisher, based at Hedeager 3, 8200 Aarhus N, with the web address www.rkkp.dk [^src1].

RKKP's role extends beyond producing the report: the organization is described as responsible for the ADHD-databasen and its indicators [^src2]. This places RKKP at the administrative center of a database that documents the quality of ADHD assessment and treatment across Danish child and adolescent psychiatry, covering the period from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024, a period in which the report notes rising referral numbers, longer waiting times, and declining achievement of most quality indicators. Notably, the report distinguishes RKKP's own analytical work from the "Regional comments" section, which falls outside RKKP's remit — that section instead reflects commentary submitted directly by Denmark's regions on their own results and challenges [^src2].

RKKP's oversight sits alongside a chairmanship of senior physicians (overlæger) from Aarhus University Hospital and DPS Midtjylland, who administer the database in practice, according to the surrounding chunk context of the report.
